reunion.speaker: mira
reunion.text: You have the look of someone bringing me another job.

reunion.speaker: mira
reunion.text: That would do it. Did he say what happened?

reunion.speaker: caelan
reunion.text: It was making a noise. Now it isn't.

reunion.speaker: mira
reunion.text: He'll want that noise back, then. Let me put this down and we'll go.

mechanism.speaker: caelan
mechanism.text: The axle's still seated. I can't see anything caught in the wheel.

mechanism.speaker: mira
mechanism.text: Nothing here explains it stopping. Let's look at the water reaching it.

race.speaker: caelan
race.text: The stream's moving, but there's hardly anything coming down the millrace.

race.speaker: mira
race.text: Then we'll follow the race back to its intake.

diagnosis.speaker: mira
diagnosis.text: The wheel isn't getting enough water to turn under load.

diagnosis.speaker: mira
diagnosis.text: That's where I'd look first. The path follows the race upstream.

intake.speaker: caelan
intake.text: That limb's wedged across the screen.

intake.speaker: mira
intake.text: And the catch is under that trapped water. We'll take the pressure off before we touch it.

prepare.speaker: mira
prepare.text: I'll set the bypass first. Stand clear of the screen.

prepare.speaker: caelan
prepare.text: Then we can get at the catch?

prepare.speaker: mira
prepare.text: Once we clear the water left in its recess.

spell_intro.speaker: mira
spell_intro.text: The pressure's off. There's just water trapped in this recess.

encouragement_failed.speaker: mira
encouragement_failed.text: You did it. I can reach the catch now.

encouragement_failed.speaker: caelan
encouragement_failed.text: I just wish it had worked at the Venns'.

encouragement_failed.speaker: mira
encouragement_failed.text: You were fighting a current there. This was a smaller job.

encouragement_failed.speaker: mira
encouragement_failed.text: And this was useful. Give yourself that much.

encouragement.speaker: mira
encouragement.text: You did it. I can reach the catch now.

encouragement.speaker: mira
encouragement.text: Exactly where we needed it. I'll take that.

repair.speaker: mira
repair.text: I'll release the catch. Keep the rope steady, then pull when I say.

verify.speaker: mira
verify.text: That's the wheel taking the load.

verify.speaker: caelan
verify.text: Sounds like Halden's noise is back.

verify.speaker: mira
verify.text: Let's tell him before he decides to take it apart himself.

resolution.speaker: halden
resolution.text: There it is. I was beginning to miss that dreadful racket.

resolution.speaker: mira
resolution.text: A limb had jammed the intake screen. We freed it and reset the catch.

resolution.speaker: mira
resolution.text: Caelan cleared the inspection recess for me. And did his share of the pulling.

resolution.speaker: caelan
resolution.text: Mira knew what we were looking at.

resolution.speaker: halden
resolution.text: Then my thanks to both of you. Now I can get on with the festival flour.

after.speaker: mira
after.text: It hasn't learned to finish itself.

halden_after.speaker: halden
halden_after.text: Listen to that. I'll take a working mill over a quiet one.

halden_waiting.speaker: halden
halden_waiting.text: I'll leave the checking to you and Mira.
